weekly_work.deliverable: Dated independent baseline, technical/indexing audit and evidence-backed prioritized backlog. Resolve verified defects before expanding content.

Improve existing project pages around supported installation, configuration and troubleshooting intents. Publish standalone tutorials only for distinct evidenced demand, with official sources and reproducible checks.
Review newly observed queries and landing pages; improve relevant internal links and answers. Keep untested titles stable and avoid generic VS expansion.

Audit execution records and compare complete windows, reporting impressions, clicks, pages with impressions and pages with clicks. Identify repeatable topics without claiming causation from tiny samples.

daily_rules: Reuse same-day GitHub snapshots; metrics refresh alone is not a content-growth improvement.
Record a verified improvement, research finding, or justified observation/blocker; do not invent work to fill a daily quota.
GitHub stars are topic-discovery evidence, not keyword search volume or product quality.
No fabricated tests, mass thin pages, unsolicited promotion, paid resources or automatic changes to editorial scores.
Deploy actual validated site changes through the existing Cloudflare Worker and verify production; operational reports alone require no deployment.
